title: hieracium incisum subsp. pallescens
intro: Hieracium incisum subsp. pallescens, commonly known as a type of Hawkweed, is a plant species that belongs to the dandelion family (Asteraceae). This plant is used in traditional medicine due to its reported health benefits, including its ability to aid in digestion, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Hieracium incisum subsp. pallescens are attributed to its ability to stimulate digestion, reduce fever, and act as a diuretic. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are believed to contribute to its medicinal properties.
